alt: 保育人員跪在巨大古樹的殘樁旁，手中舊照片裡茂密的原始森林，如今只剩遍地樹樁與荒土。
scene_prompt: Illustrate 萬劫不復 in its meaning of irreversible devastating destruction that no effort can restore, using a contemporary ecological conservation scene, not hell or injury. A middle-aged conservation worker wearing an ordinary outdoor jacket kneels safely beside the enormous stump of a centuries-old tree. The entire surrounding once-unique ancient forest has been bulldozed into a barren wasteland of cut stumps, exposed dry earth and discarded broken branches stretching into the distance. An abandoned motionless yellow excavator sits far back, all tracks correctly on the ground. The worker holds in ONE hand an old unlettered photograph showing this very same valley formerly lush with its enormous ancient tree, while the other hand rests helplessly on the giant stump. Expression is stunned remorse and grief, shoulders slumped. Clear comparison of the photo's irreplaceable old-growth habitat and the ruined land establishes that this is catastrophic permanent loss, not normal gardening or a tree being pruned. Keep scene child-appropriate, no people in danger, no dead animals or blood, no new saplings suggesting quick recovery. One human only with exactly two arms and two legs, coherent hands and clothing, plausible scale and perspective. Visible tree growth rings convey centuries of loss, not written numerals. No word bubbles or thought bubbles.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D, or imitation of a named artist.
